description: This PHP source file is a controller class for managing cron jobs within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically within the admin marketplace module. It provides methods for listing, running, enabling, disabling, and deleting cron jobs, handling permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: A controller class in the Opencart admin module for managing marketplace cron jobs, including CRUD operations and execution control.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to render the cron management page with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to return the list of crons.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the paginated list view of cron jobs as HTML.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specific cron job identified by 'cron_id'.
